description:
Render the short id the server provides, so no web code derives a short id by truncation.

## Background

The web UI truncates issue ids with `substring(0, 8)` at `web/src/components/Issue/IssueDetail.tsx:295,460`, `web/src/components/Graph/nodes/ClusterNode.tsx:106` and `web/src/components/Graph/GraphView.tsx:214,715`. Issue and graph responses carry a `short_id` derived by the domain. Commit-hash truncation (`IssueDetail.tsx:701`, `components/Document/DocumentViewer.tsx:278,345`) is not issue identity.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The web issue and graph types declare the server's `short_id` fields.
- [hard] REQ-02: The five issue-id truncation sites render the provided short id, and no web source truncates an issue id by length.
- [hard] REQ-03: Web tests, lint and build pass.
title: Web UI renders the server-provided short id
